The issuer has solid balance sheet strength with shareholders’ equity of 3,435M (about 57% of total assets) and manageable leverage (total liabilities of 2,528M). Liquidity is also adequate with a current ratio of roughly 1.75, and profitability is decent (net margin ~10% and EBIT margin ~8%), supporting continued operating coverage. Overall, these factors point to an investment-grade credit profile, though lack of detailed debt/coverage metrics prevents a higher rating.

DECISION: A-
